chars: the young man in the black T-shirt
the young woman in the fur-collared coat
moments.action: On a dark hilltop the young man in the black tee grins down at the woman beside him; the shot widens to his friends packed around them, the mood still loose and celebratory.

chars: the older man in the black hat and long coat
the young man in the black T-shirt
moments.action: Three men in black, one in a wide-brimmed hat, walk up out of the dark; a wide shot lines the whole crowd up facing them, and by the reverse the young man's smile is gone.

chars: the older man in the black hat and long coat
the young man in the black T-shirt
the young woman in the fur-collared coat
moments.action: The hatted man speaks straight at the young man, who lowers his eyes and takes it; the older man's own face sags as he talks, and by the last shot the couple are staring back, braced.

chars: the older man in the black hat and long coat
the young man in the black T-shirt
the young woman in the fur-collared coat
moments.action: The exchange hardens: the hatted man presses, the young man looks off past him, a wider shot puts the older man hemmed in by the group, then he drops his head and turns away from them.
Cut to a packed night garage meet - a blurred sweep past a blue coupe, a woman leaning into its door, a mechanic bent over a turbo engine, hands thrown up in the crowd, cars shown off.
moments.censor_note: shot 14: woman leaning into the car door, bra and cleavage exposed, occupies roughly the centre third of frame; surrounding shots show midriffs and short skirts in passing

chars: the young man in the green jacket and white do-rag
moments.action: Money comes out - the young man in the green jacket collects fistfuls of cash handed over by the crowd - then the camera slides off onto engine bays, spoilers and race numbers as bets are settled.

chars: the young man in the green jacket and white do-rag
the young man in the black T-shirt
the young woman in the red top
moments.action: The green-jacketed man pushes through the crowd; across the garage the man in the black tee is leaning on a car working a group of women, and the newcomer closes in on him.

chars: the young man in the black T-shirt
the young man in the green jacket and white do-rag
moments.action: The man in the black tee turns at being called and the two trade lines over his shoulder; his wary look loosens into a smirk while the younger man stays flat and serious.

chars: the young woman in the red top
the young man in the black T-shirt
the young man in the green jacket and white do-rag
moments.action: The woman in the red top steps in front of him and holds his eye, smiling; cut back to the younger man still talking, then to the man in the black tee - the smirk gone, her face blurred behind him.

chars: the young man in the black T-shirt
moments.action: The crowd keeps drifting past the parked cars; the man in the black tee holds a long near-motionless close-up with his eyes lowered, then a low wide shot shows the garage carrying on around him.
